## History

Seven years prior to the events of the story, Mrs. Spencer brought [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) over from Hopetown on a boat. When a mix-up occurred and a young girl was delivered to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the expected boy, [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to Mrs. Spencer's home to resolve the mistake.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P32](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the child of Mrs. Spencer. Her mother acts as her parent throughout their appearances in the story. She resides in the Spencer household where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visit to resolve the orphan adoption mix-up.

- Parent of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004)</sub>
